newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Thailand's TAC signs $222 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Thailand's TAC signs $222 mln credit.

text.p: LONDON, Sept 5 (LPC) - Total Access Communications (TAC), Thailand's second largest cellular telephone operator, has signed a $222 million long term buyer credit facility, the company announced.

The credit, which was arranged by Chase Manhattan and Citicorp Investment Bank, will finance the purchase of $273 million worth of cellular telephone switching and other equipment from Nokia Telecommunications Ltd of the UK, Nokia Telecommunications Oy of Finland and Motorola Ltd of the UK.
The deal is split between a $120 million Finnish Export Credit and a 66 million sterling export buyer credit supported by a guarantee from the UK's Export Credit Guarantee Department.
TAC, is a subsidiary of Thailand's United Communications Industry, and in 1995 had approximately 37 per cent of Thailand's cellular telephone market, according to the company.
